annotations.text:
Green ink: the settled system.

One surface, no card grid: structure comes from hairline rules and a real type scale (Schibsted Grotesk + Spline Sans Mono). One brand color, pine green, because Proof means approval; it does actions, links and 'pass'. Severity is colored glyphs and numerals, never pills. The score is the page's focal point.

Motion: the score counts up, category bars fill, rows rise, and the run state shows a scanning sheet. The Motion board holds the timings.

Implemented in the app code.
Earlier directions, kept for the record: A · Galley (paper/red-pen), B · Ledger (instrument, two polish passes), C · Studio (poster). All superseded by Green ink.

Three landing directions, all inside Green ink. Pick one or mix.

A · Proof desk: the product is the hero. An oversized marked-up sheet with margin notes and the score printed on it. Most informative; also the densest.

B · Poster proof: pure typography. A weak resume line struck in red becomes a strong one in green, at poster scale. Boldest and instantly understood; shows no UI.

C · Night shift: dark ground, one lit sheet under a green scan line. Highest drama and contrast; the landing flips brightness against the light app.
